protocol.split: assigned 1,000-query ESCI NDCG training split only
protocol.tasks: Separate Referee task per baseline and model; exact ID/text/locale match verified.
protocol.retrieval: Frozen as 7e22661 identifier-gated RRF first stage: locale-filtered Voyage-4 passage ANN and weighted title/description BM25, top 100 per arm; passage included in both arms.
protocol.baseline: Local identifier-gated RRF, rank constant 10, base weights 2:1.
protocol.model_reranking: Outer rerank_by on the two-arm multi-query; no local RRF before model scoring; deduplicated candidate union; final top 10.
protocol.cache: No application candidate/result cache; requests executed serially, one variant at a time.
protocol.latency: Client end-to-end latency for successful request attempts; 429 retries backed off and are counted separately.
protocol.cost: No model usage or model billing metric was returned. A chars/4 token proxy is shown for native models only; monetary cost is unavailable.
protocol.paired_ci: 95% normal-approximation interval over per-query paired NDCG@10 differences.
protocol.execution_notes: An initial setup attempt stopped at locale normalization before any namespace query. A later baseline attempt was stopped by the 120-second shell limit during retrieval, and another completed all 1,000 baseline queries but stopped before Referee submission due to a local output-file bug. Their partial request/retry/latency details were not retained and are excluded from the reported complete run. The successful run submitted 1,000 queries for each of its three tasks.
protocol.holdout_access: Holdout tokens, tasks, and artifacts were not accessed. The aggregate-only holdout metrics below were supplied by the orchestrator.
